hook: The BYD Seagull can charge from 10% to 70% in five minutes.
hooks: The BYD Seagull can charge from 10% to 70% in five minutes.
It can fill most of its battery in five minutes.
BYD says the Seagull charges from 10% to 70% in five minutes.
what_happened: BYD introduced the Seagull EV hatchback that can charge from 10% to 70% in five minutes using its Flash Charging system.
why_it_matters: It lets owners add most of the driving range in a coffee‑break, reducing charging stops.
the_catch: It only works with BYD’s dedicated Flash Charging stations, which are currently limited to China.
caption: The BYD Seagull EV hatchback can charge from 10% to 70% in just five minutes using its Flash Charging system. Five minutes enough?
alt_text: The slides explain that the BYD Seagull EV can charge from 10% to 70% in five minutes, needs special stations, and the limitation of current availability.
